5.4.2.1.2 Data Element with Status
[SWS_Rte_01365]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈The data type for a “data element with status” shall be named Rte_DES_<dt> where
<dt> is the data element’s ImplementationDataType name.⌋
[SWS_Rte_01366]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈A data element with status shall be a structure containing exactly two mem-
bers.⌋
[SWS_Rte_03734]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈The first member of each data element with status shall be named ’value’⌋
[SWS_Rte_02666]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The value member of a data element with status shall have the type of the
corresponding data element.⌋
[SWS_Rte_02589]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The second member of each data element with status shall be named ’sta-
tus’.⌋
[SWS_Rte_02590]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The
status
member
of
a
data element with status
shall
be
of
the
Std_ReturnType type.⌋
[SWS_Rte_02609]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078
⌈In case of read access, the status member of a data element with status shall
contain the error status corresponding to the value member.⌋
[SWS_Rte_03836]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00185
⌈In case of write access, the status member of a data element with status shall
contain the transmission status corresponding to the value member.⌋
